_comment: Lebanon insurers/TPA/hospital-finance pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot is the only change from the source text. No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
subject_template: The manual work behind your health claims
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope all's well on your end. I've been looking at how claims actually move through insurers and TPAs in Lebanon, and I've noticed the same bottleneck everywhere: a claim arrives as a stack of papers, someone retypes it into the system, someone else checks it line by line, and a file that should take minutes ends up taking days. Since the war, the pile has only grown.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where a business is losing time and money and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Could we set up a 20 minute call to go through the details? My direct line is +961 76 412 978 if you'd rather just call.

Best regards,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
